name: diskwise
description: Disk hygiene while the agent works, plus a disk-space specialist with safe, undoable cleanup and verified backups.

interface.shortDescription: Keep your disk lean while you work
interface.longDescription: Keeps workspaces free of version copies, scratch files and uncompressed intermediates, and frees disk space safely: caches, build folders, duplicates, extracted archives, git bloat, with quarantine-first removal and hash-verified backups.
defaultPrompt: My disk is almost full. Find what I can safely remove.
